'''Clue scroll (beginner)''' is a [[hot and cold clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|text=Buried beneath the ground, who knows where it's found. Lucky for you, A man called Reldo may have a clue.
|items=[[Spade]], [[strange device]].
|notes=Speak to [[Reldo]] to receive a [[strange device]] used by [[Hot and cold clues]] to locate the location of the next clue.

Players can immediately start the search without speaking to [[Reldo]] if they already own a [[strange device]].

To find your location, click on the strange device and it will tell you how close you are to the treasure. Its temperature is based on the distance of the treasure from the player, measured in the number of steps it would take to reach the treasure, ignoring any obstacles. Then, teleport or walk to another location, and check to see if the strange device has gotten warmer. Repeat to pinpoint a location. You can also use [[Treasure_Trails/Guide/Hot_Cold#Beginner_Hot_Cold_clue_locations|this list of solutions]] to help you find your location. For each location, there is a 7x7 square in which you can dig to find the treasure.
|map={{Map|3210,3495|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}}}

==Transportation==
The following are effective methods of reaching [[Reldo]] to obtain a [[strange device]]:

*[[Varrock Teleport]] and run north to [[Varrock Palace]].
*[[Achievement diary cape]] teleport to [[Toby]].
*[[Spirit tree]] to the [[Grand Exchange]].
*[[Ring of wealth]] teleport to the [[Grand Exchange]].
*[[Chronicle]] teleport and run north.
*[[Combat bracelet]] teleport to the [[Champion's Guild]].
